comments.author: @pinetrees-r7w
comments.text:
Timestamp 10:09 - Can people drink beer in public??  You say yes, "Generally prohibited
Can you drink beer in public spaces in Poland?  In Poland, drinking beer in public spaces is generally prohibited. However, there are designated "drinking zones" where consumption is allowed. These zones are typically within licensed hospitality terraces or specially marked festival grounds. Violations in these zones are subject to immediate fines and possible detention. The new rules also expand the definition of "public place" to include streets, squares, parks, and transport hubs unless a local ordinance expressly authorizes consumption. Tourists should seek out the blue-marked "drinking zones" commonly displayed on city maps and at major attractions".
